versions.content: Modeling of SecuredIPdu in case useAsCrypto- graphicIPdu is set to true If the useAsCryptographicIPdu is set to true then the SecuredIPdu and the payload IPdu shall be • mapped into a Frame by the PduToFrameMapping or • assigned to SocketConnectionBundle or SocketConnection or • assigned to ContainerIPdu
